offers_products.reason: Manufactures bottle filling stations, drinking fountains, washroom partitions, water heaters, sinks, drains, backflow preventers and hand dryers.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured plumbing and water products; no main service offering described.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Elkay residential faucets, sinks, filtered water dispensers and Mexico residential sinks, though most sales go through channels.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to commercial, municipal, healthcare, school and industrial buyers, including contractors and distributors, for building projects.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mostly new-construction and retrofit product sales tied to projects, not subscriptions or contracts, though repeat orders and replacements occur.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand depends heavily on new commercial construction and renovation, which can be delayed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Individual fixtures, fountains, drains and valves are modest purchases bought frequently through distributors, not large infrequent sales.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from manufactured goods and engineered products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Sells through distributors to many contractors, plumbers and building owners; buyers are fragmented, not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Light-to-moderate manufacturing of plumbing products; not heavy plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Large-customer and asset-heavy answers are judgment calls from the product mix and distribution channels.
